title: Door Hanger Marketing Guide: Design Tips, Costs & Distribution | 2026

facts.fact: A 2023 McKinsey report, as cited by the page, found that 70% of consumers find direct mail more personal than online interactions.
facts.quote: Despite the rise of digital marketing, 70% of consumers find direct mail more personal than online interactions, according to a 2023 McKinsey report.

facts.fact: The page states, without naming a source, that people process images 60,000 times faster than text.
facts.quote: Psychological studies show that people process images 60,000 times faster than text.

facts.fact: According to a 2024 Nielsen study cited by the page, local advertising including door hangers can boost in-store visits by up to 30% for retail businesses.
facts.quote: According to a 2024 Nielsen study, local advertising, including door hangers, can boost in-store visits by up to 30% for retail businesses.

facts.fact: Universal Mailworks' estimate for printing 1,000 door hanger pieces (14pt C2S, 4/4 color) is $0.25 to $0.40 per piece, or $250 to $400 total.
Universal Mailworks' estimate for printing 5,000 door hanger pieces (14pt C2S, 4/4 color) is $0.12 to $0.20 per piece, or $600 to $1,000 total.
Universal Mailworks' estimate for printing 10,000 door hanger pieces (14pt C2S, 4/4 color) is $0.08 to $0.15 per piece, or $800 to $1,500 total.
Universal Mailworks' estimate for printing 25,000 or more door hanger pieces (14pt C2S, 4/4 color) is $0.05 to $0.10 per piece, or $1,250 to $2,500+ total.
The page states that professional door-to-door distribution of door hangers typically costs $0.08 to $0.25 per piece, depending on area density, route complexity, and quantity.
facts.quote: Costs typically range from $0.08 to $0.25 per piece, depending on the area's density, route complexity, and quantity.

facts.fact: The page recommends budgeting a contingency of 5-10% of the campaign budget for unexpected costs or design revisions.
facts.quote: always factor in a small contingency (5-10%) for unexpected costs or design revisions.

facts.fact: Universal Mailworks claims it can provide a custom pricing quote in under 2 hours, with no obligation.
facts.quote: Get custom pricing in under 2 hours — no obligation.

facts.fact: According to HubSpot's 2024 marketing report (a third-party source cited by Universal Mailworks), companies that regularly A/B test their marketing materials experience an average of 20-30% higher conversion rates than those that don't.
facts.quote: Companies that regularly A/B test their marketing materials experience an average of 20-30% higher conversion rates compared to those that don't, according to HubSpot's 2024 marketing report.
